question: According to the slides, what happens when the price is above the equilibrium price P*?

fixture_slides.title: Market Equilibrium Condition
fixture_slides.text: Equilibrium: Qd(P*) = Qs(P*). Above P*, excess supply (a surplus) puts downward pressure on price. Below P*, excess demand (a shortage) puts upward pressure on price.

mock_reply:
